metadata.title: Prophetica - Sports Prediction
metadata.description: Prophetica Sports is a sports event prediction landing page with neutral matching and responsible play.

legal.body: Use is limited to players aged 18 or older. Prophetica is an entertainment service, not gambling, lottery, or a financial derivative.

noScript.headline: JavaScript is required
noScript.body: Language switching, sign-in, and account setup require JavaScript.

hero.headline: Read the match. Price the moment.
hero.tagline: Track sports events, form a prediction view, and match with other players through a neutral matching engine.

neutral.headline: Neutral matching, never player counterparty.
neutral.tagline: Prophetica Sports provides event prediction markets and matching services. The platform does not promise returns, guarantee win rates, or act as counterparty.

points.headline: Manage prediction pace with points.
points.tagline: Enter markets with in-app virtual points, limits, records, and clear transaction states for every prediction.

responsibleGaming.headline: Responsible play tools come first.
responsibleGaming.tagline: Check budget and risk before starting, with limits, cooldown, self-exclusion, and support resources when needed.

start.headline: Enter your first sports market when ready.
start.tagline: After signup, complete required account setup, browse markets at your pace, understand rules, and create predictions.
